title: A Second Door
short_role: Decide whether Mara's repaired Workshop should gain a service route or remain compact.
setup: Mara proposes a narrow service door between the Workshop lane and the yard.

castellan.setup: Mara proposes cutting a service door through the compact support line. The Castellan sees faster repair access and one more opening to control.

warden.setup: Mara proposes a service door into the yard. The Warden sees a deliberate response lane that must remain clear.

choices.label: Open the service door
choices.visible_result: Mara leaves a second repair route open; future plans must treat it as both access and exposure.

choices.label: Keep one Workshop entry
choices.visible_result: Mara keeps the Workshop compact and records that repair access must come through the existing lane.
